extendedDescription:
**SignAI** is a deep learning project focused on interpreting *Chilean Sign Language (LSCh)* through computer vision. I led the technical direction of the project, developing an end-to-end system that combined image processing, neural network inference, a `FastAPI` backend, and real-time web applications using `WebSockets`.
The project explored how machine learning could contribute to more accessible communication technologies for the Chilean deaf community. SignAI received **1st place in Social Impact** and **2nd place in Project of the Year** at DuocUC's national project fair, while also achieving the **highest grade in its Capstone section with a 6.7/7.0**.
